name: Aqara Door and Window Sensor P2 (EU)

radios.note: Aqara's spec lists Thread and BLE; CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth.

matter.note: CSA lists Door and Window Sensor P2 from Lumi United (vendor 0x115F, product 0x2002). Models are DW-S02E and DW-S02D.

apple_home.note: Aqara lists it as compatible; Matter use needs a Matter-compatible Thread border router. On Apple that means a HomePod mini, HomePod 2nd gen or Apple TV 4K.

google_home.note: Aqara lists it as compatible; Matter use needs a Matter-compatible Thread border router.

alexa.note: Aqara lists it as compatible; Matter use needs a Matter-compatible Thread border router.

smartthings.note: Aqara lists it as compatible; Matter use needs a Matter-compatible Thread border router.

home_assistant.note: Aqara's product page lists Home Assistant Yellow among tested Matter controller and Thread border routers. Reached through Home Assistant's Matter integration.

hubRequired.note: No Aqara hub is needed for Matter control; it needs a Matter controller with a Thread border router (e.g. HomePod mini, Nest Hub 2nd gen, Echo 4th gen), which is not a brand hub. The Aqara Home app and extras such as the tamper alert need Aqara's Hub M3.

localControl.note: No Aqara source we saw states local-only control.

senses.note: Aqara's spec lists a Hall sensor for open/closed state, plus a tamper alarm.

summary: Aqara Door and Window Sensor P2 uses a Hall sensor to report open or closed and has a tamper alarm. It reaches Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant over Matter on Thread, so you need a Matter-compatible Thread border router but not an Aqara hub. Power is one CR123A cell.
caveats: Needs a Matter-compatible Thread border router, such as a HomePod mini, Nest Hub 2nd gen or Echo 4th gen.
The Aqara Home app and extras like the tamper alert need Aqara's Hub M3.
